text: This report provides the Audit Results, as prepared by KPMG, to assist the Board in reviewing the financial statements for the year ended 2022-12-31. The Audit Results Report was reviewed and discussed at the Policy and Finance Committee meeting on 2023-05-31 and was received for information.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report (May 31, 2023) from the Controller, Finance, Toronto Zoo for information.
